description.en:
Linglong 2.0 is a full-size humanoid platform associated with the OpenLoong open-source community. It combines robot hardware with an open software architecture for developing and testing movement, perception and embodied-intelligence applications. The platform is also used for hands-on algorithm validation in OpenLoong's developer competitions.

The community describes long-distance outdoor running and integration with domestic computing platforms as part of its development work. Those trials demonstrate particular configurations and conditions. The open ecosystem is intended to support continued hardware-software iteration, with the chosen controller and software release identified when reproducing results.
